title: Block - Summit Registration Form

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: heading
fields.instructions: Optional. The current page uses "REGISTER YOUR PLACE".

fields.label: Sub-heading
fields.name: description
fields.instructions: Small line under the heading. The current page uses "Fields marked * are required.".

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.name: intro
fields.instructions: Leave blank to use the wording from the HubSpot form this replaced (personal invitation, do not forward, two attendees per company).

fields.label: Note under the date field
fields.name: date_note
fields.instructions: Leave blank to use the existing N.B. wording about the event running on two dates.

fields.label: Consent paragraph
fields.name: consent_text
fields.instructions: Leave blank to use the existing legitimate-interest wording. The words "privacy policy" are linked automatically if a privacy policy URL is set below.

fields.label: Privacy policy URL
fields.name: privacy_url
fields.instructions: Links the words "privacy policy" in the consent paragraph. If this is empty the text stays unlinked rather than pointing somewhere invented.

fields.label: Success heading
fields.name: success_heading
fields.instructions: Shown in place of the form once someone has registered. Defaults to "Thank you, your place is registered.".

fields.label: Success message
fields.name: success_text
fields.instructions: Defaults to "We will confirm your date in due course.".

description: Copy for the invite-only Summit registration form. The invite list and the two-per-company cap are not editable here: they live in the mb_summit_invites option and Theme/Summit/Gate.php.
